name: Sound Test
author: Mr.Rafael
description: A mouse-driven sound lab for WASM-4 with draggable controls and a simple music composer, handy for finding sound effects. X or Z changes the palette.

descriptions.en: A mouse-driven sound lab for WASM-4 with draggable controls and a simple music composer, handy for finding sound effects. X or Z changes the palette.
descriptions.it: Un laboratorio sonoro per WASM-4 da usare col mouse, con controlli trascinabili e un semplice compositore musicale, utile per trovare effetti. X o Z cambia palette.
